source_title: Canelo vs. Mbilli Livestream: Where to Watch the Fight Online
source_excerpt:
If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission.
Canelo returns to face WBC super middleweight champion Mbilli in the “Mexico vs. The World” boxing event on Saturday, Oct. 31 in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Main card coverage begins at 10 a.m. PT/1 p.m. ET, available exclusively on DAZN Pay-Per-View (PPV) .
The standalone event costs $79.99. Alternatively, for those with a DAZN Ultimate subscription (starting at $49.99 per month with an annual contract), the fight is included at no extra cost (more on this package below). Main event ring walks are expected at 1:30 p.m. PT/4:30 p.m. ET. Where to Watch Canelo vs. Mbilli: Streaming Date, Schedule
The highly-anticipated “Mexico vs. The World” card takes place in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia on Saturday, Oct. 31. Coverage will begin at 10 a.m. PT/1 p.m. ET, while the main event ring walks will take place at approximately 1:30 p.m. PT/4:30 p.m. ET.
The Halloween fight will stream exclusively on DAZN PPV , which costs $79.99 for the standalone event .
Alternatively, a DAZN Ultimate subscription (starting at $49.99 per month) includes the fight at no extra cost. The package includes a minimum of 12 pay-per-views per year, 185-plus fights a year from the world’s best promoters, HDR and Dolby 5.1 surround sound on select events and more.
